title: Care Centre Guidance: Claims Deducted from a Harbison Labor-Only Protection Cancellation Refund
content:
**The rule.** The claims deducted on the cancellation of a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts follow the contract's claim history, measured back from the date of confirmation:

1. Where an original decision was posted on the contract within the 30 recent-decision days before the date of confirmation, the claims deducted are the larger of the total of every claim payout made on the contract and the total approved on its original decisions (the approved and partially approved ones).
2. Where no decision is that recent and the latest claim payout was made more than 1095 days (the forgiven-payout age) before the date of confirmation, or no payout was ever made, nothing is deducted.
3. Otherwise the claims deducted are every claim payout made.

**Both sides of each boundary.**

| Latest original decision, days before confirmation | Latest claim payout, days before confirmation | Claims deducted |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | any | the larger of total payouts and total approved on original decisions |
| 31 | 1096 | nothing |
| 31 | 1095 | every claim payout made |
| none | none ever made | nothing |

**Illustrations (hypothetical histories).**

- An original decision approving $640.00 was posted 12 days before confirmation and has not yet been paid; earlier payouts total $300.00 and earlier approvals $300.00. Total approved on original decisions $940.00 against payouts $300.00: claims deducted **$940.00**.
- The last decision was two years ago and the last payout, of $450.00, was made 700 days before confirmation, with payouts totalling $450.00: claims deducted **$450.00**.
- The only payout, $1200.00, was made four years before confirmation and no decision is recent: claims deducted **$0.00**.
